text:
Type: round bentwood stacking stool
Use: extra seating, bedside table, plant stand; dining room, kitchen, living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: birch veneer seat, bent laminated birch plywood legs
Colors: pale natural birch, light blond wood
Shape: round disc seat on four L-shaped legs that curve sharply under the rim, exposed layered plywood edges, stackable, compact and light
Feel: light, friendly, classic, airy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, colorful textiles; Scandinavian, mid-century or minimalist rooms

product.name: FROSTA
product.description: The stool can be stacked, so you can keep several on hand and store them on the same space as one.
